verdict.rationale: treg documents a first-party hosted MCP endpoint at https://treg.to/mcp and a Claude connector page that uses OAuth with PKCE. Named MCP tools such as `review(call_id, ...)` and `balance` are documented, the Claude plugin installs with no token, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use.
